with child as (
    select customer_id as from_field
    from "olist"."staging"."stg_orders"
    where customer_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select customer_id as to_field
    from "olist"."staging"."stg_customers"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select category
from "olist"."staging"."stg_product_category_name_translation"
where category is null

-- Each child relation is reduced to one row per order BEFORE joining.
with items as (
    select order_id, sum(price) as merchandise_value, sum(freight) as freight_value,
           count(*) as item_count, count(distinct seller_id) as seller_count
    from "olist"."staging"."stg_order_items" group by 1
), payments as (
    select order_id, sum(payment_value) as payment_value
    from "olist"."staging"."stg_order_payments" group by 1
), reviews as (
    select *, row_number() over (
        partition by order_id order by answered_at desc nulls last, review_id desc, score desc
    ) as position from "olist"."staging"."stg_order_reviews"
)
select o.*, c.customer_unique_id, c.state as customer_state,
       coalesce(i.merchandise_value,0) as merchandise_value,
       coalesce(i.freight_value,0) as freight_value,
       coalesce(i.item_count,0) as item_count, coalesce(i.seller_count,0) as seller_count,
       p.payment_value, r.score as review_score,
       case when o.delivered_at is not null and o.estimated_at is not null
            then o.delivered_at::date > o.estimated_at::date end as is_late,
       extract(epoch from (o.delivered_at-o.purchased_at))/86400.0 as delivery_days
from "olist"."staging"."stg_orders" o
join "olist"."staging"."stg_customers" c using (customer_id)
left join items i using (order_id)
left join payments p using (order_id)
left join reviews r on o.order_id=r.order_id and r.position=1

-- Purchase-cohort snapshot, not a reconstruction of status as known on that date.
select * from "olist"."intermediate"."int_order_totals"
where purchased_at < '2018-08-31'::date + interval '1 day'

with customers as (
    select customer_unique_id, '2018-08-31'::date-max(purchased_at)::date as recency_days,
           count(*) as frequency, sum(merchandise_value) as monetary_value
    from "olist"."marts"."fct_orders" where order_status='delivered' group by 1
)
select *, case when frequency>=2 and recency_days<=90 then 'Repeat active'
               when frequency>=2 then 'Repeat dormant'
               when recency_days<=90 then 'New / recent'
               else 'One-time dormant' end as segment,
       cume_dist() over(order by monetary_value) as monetary_percentile
from customers

with calendar as (
    select generate_series(min(purchased_at)::date, '2018-08-31'::date, interval '1 day')::date as day
    from "olist"."marts"."fct_orders"
), daily as (
    select purchased_at::date as day, count(*) as orders,
           sum(merchandise_value) as gmv, sum(freight_value) as freight
    from "olist"."marts"."fct_orders" where order_status='delivered' group by 1
)
select c.day, coalesce(d.orders,0) as orders, coalesce(d.gmv,0) as gmv,
       coalesce(d.freight,0) as freight, d.gmv/nullif(d.orders,0) as aov
from calendar c left join daily d using(day)

select customer_state, count(*) as delivered_orders,
       count(*) filter(where is_late is not null) as delivery_denominator,
       avg(is_late::int) as late_rate, avg(delivery_days) as mean_delivery_days,
       avg(review_score) filter(where is_late) as late_review_score,
       avg(review_score) filter(where not is_late) as on_time_review_score
from "olist"."marts"."fct_orders" where order_status='delivered' group by 1

select order_id
from "olist"."marts"."fct_orders"
where order_id is null

-- One first-observed customer order, with a full 90-day post-delivery window.
-- Final delivery statuses are retrospective, not reconstructed event-time states.
with ranked as (
    select *,row_number() over(partition by customer_unique_id order by purchased_at,order_id) as purchase_rank
    from "olist"."marts"."fct_orders"
), eligible as (
    select * from ranked
    where purchase_rank=1 and order_status='delivered'
      and purchased_at >= '2017-01-01'::date
      and delivered_at >= purchased_at and is_late is not null
      and delivered_at + interval '90 days' < '2018-07-31'::date + interval '1 day'
), outcomes as (
    select f.customer_unique_id,f.order_id as first_order_id,f.purchased_at as first_purchase_at,
           f.delivered_at as first_delivered_at,f.customer_state,
           date_trunc('month',f.purchased_at)::date as first_purchase_month,
           f.is_late as first_is_late,f.merchandise_value as first_gmv,
           count(o.order_id) filter(where o.purchased_at<=f.delivered_at+interval '30 days') as orders_30d,
           count(o.order_id) filter(where o.purchased_at<=f.delivered_at+interval '60 days') as orders_60d,
           count(o.order_id) as orders_90d,coalesce(sum(o.merchandise_value),0) as followup_gmv_90d
    from eligible f left join "olist"."marts"."fct_orders" o
      on f.customer_unique_id=o.customer_unique_id and o.order_id<>f.order_id
      and o.order_status='delivered' and o.purchased_at>f.delivered_at
      and o.purchased_at<=f.delivered_at+interval '90 days'
    group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8
)
select *,orders_30d>0 as repeat_30d,orders_60d>0 as repeat_60d,orders_90d>0 as repeat_90d,
       case when first_gmv<50 then 'Under 50' when first_gmv<100 then '50 to 99'
            when first_gmv<200 then '100 to 199' else '200 or more' end as basket_band
from outcomes

with months as (
    select date_trunc('month',day)::date as month, sum(orders) as orders, sum(gmv) as gmv
    from "olist"."marts"."daily_sales" group by 1
), compared as (
    select *, lag(gmv) over(order by month) as previous_gmv,
           sum(gmv) over(order by month) as cumulative_gmv from months
)
select *, (gmv/ nullif(previous_gmv,0)-1)*100 as mom_pct,
       gmv/nullif(orders,0) as aov from compared

select date_trunc('week',day)::date as week, sum(orders) as orders, sum(gmv) as gmv,
       sum(gmv)/nullif(sum(orders),0) as aov, count(*)=7 as is_complete_week
from "olist"."marts"."daily_sales" group by 1
